/**
 * The scriptable client nexus `Chat.IChatClient` of the cross-language test harness.
 *
 * Every call hands its typed-JSON arguments to the script host, which runs the slot's script, and completes with the typed-JSON result converted back. `onConnected` and `onDisconnected` run their slots without waiting for them. Fire-and-forget methods drop their result and errors.
 */
export declare class ChatScriptableNexus extends $m.ChatClientNexusBase {
  /**
   * Creates the nexus.
   *
   * @param host Runs the scripts of its calls.
   */
  constructor(host: $sr.ScriptHost);
  protected square(value: number, cancellationToken: AbortSignal): Promise<number>;
  protected message(text: string, money: unknown): void;
  protected receive(pipe: $rt.NexusDuplexPipe): Promise<void>;
  protected feed(count: number, channel: $rt.NexusDuplexChannel<Item>): Promise<void>;
  protected heavy(): Promise<void>;
  protected context_(box: Box<string>, item: Item | null): Promise<Array<Item> | null>;
  protected onConnected_(arguments_: number, context: number, methodId: number): Promise<void>;
  protected pick(colors: Array<Color>, map: Map<number, string> | null): Promise<Color>;
  onConnected(isReconnected: boolean): void;
  onDisconnected(): void;
}

import { ChatScaffolding } from './ChatScaffolding.js';

/** The `schemaHash` of the language host's `hello` (control protocol §4.6): the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the `nexnet-ir.json` this code was generated from. */
export const SCHEMA_HASH = '<sha256 of the IR, see SchemaHashIsTheSha256OfTheIrFile>';

/** The exports, in IR order. */
export const EXPORTS = Object.freeze([ChatScaffolding]);

/**
 * The export of a nexus pair, as `client.create` names it.
 *
 * @param {string} clientNexus The full metadata name of the C# client nexus interface.
 * @param {string} serverNexus The full metadata name of the C# server nexus interface.
 * @returns {import('./scaffolding-runtime.js').ScaffoldingExport<any> | null} The export, or null when there is none for the pair.
 */
export function find(clientNexus, serverNexus) {
  return EXPORTS.find((e) => e.clientNexus === clientNexus && e.serverNexus === serverNexus) ?? null;
}
